fields.raw_explanation: Step 1: "The funnel structure and email sequence already created — so the SMS sequence complements without duplicating what the emails say." No Email Sequence asset/prompt exists anywhere else in this system, so this is modeled as an optional reference that is silently skipped (not asked about, not blocking) if the context key doesn't exist, rather than the standard ask_user_if_missing fallback.
